name: List
summary: A bordered, evenly-divided column of uniform rows.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-list> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; each light-DOM child becomes a row, the last row drops its divider, and rows highlight on hover. `list-title` renders an optional header. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: (children)
props.desc: Each light-DOM child renders as one divided row

whenToUse.when: many uniform rows of the same shape (recent items, participants)
multi-column records that need sorting or alignment
one titled group of mixed content

opinion.note: Keep rows to one shape — a label, or a label plus a trailing control. For dense multi-column data reach for the Table instead.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no List cell; spec derived from the token layer (radius-lg, border, split, bg-hover, text-default/secondary) + antd List conventions. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.
